items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: And in my music career, I began working with a lady from New Orleans by the name of Alma Hightower

ctx.x: So it's all going right now. So you can start off with your name, I guess.

My name is Clem Raymond. My age is 65. I live downtown, San Bernard and Durginwa Street, New Orleans. My first instruction was Papa Teal. Later, I move uptown, Cater's and Liberty Street, and I start taking lessons with old man Umfrey. Later in years, I left New Orleans to New York. I was working for the United Fruit Company Boat Company. There I met a bunch of boys from New Orleans by the name of the Johnson Brothers, which encouraged me to leave the boat and work as music. And that's the encouragement I had…
I was going to ask first of all the exact birth date, when your birth date is?
